prompt: In 1K4C, colour by molecule: entity 1 (protein) cyan and entity 3 (protein) blue. Leave the other entities alone.

checks: schema-valid; replays with nothing ignored or unresolved (scripts/check_api_refs.py)

each of the 2 selection(s) selects exactly the atoms written a second time in provenance.targets (author chain, author number and residue name, or label chains / label ranges from the frozen facts), resolved by molbench.atoms
the reference grades as exactly right against the task (F1 1, success, target score 1)
a near miss (first colour changed, or last step dropped) is not a success and earns partial credit (F1 0.75)
equivalent answer succeeds: the entity's label chains, one by one
wrong answer fails: entity ids as numbers (the viewer compares with ===, so 2 never equals "2") (F1 0.0)
provenance.derived: Two polymer entities drawn by seed from the frozen facts; the intended atoms are the entity's label chains as the facts list them.
